contents.text: 恭喜你成功完成尋寶任務(3)！你看到了什麼魚呢？在瑠公農田水利會（今之農業部農田水利署瑠公管理處）支持下，舟山路農場生態池（瑠公圳水源池）於2004年完工，並以生態綠化、永續、保育及教育等出發點，成為校園重要景點，同時也為校園內鳥類、兩棲類及爬蟲類動物躲藏棲地。讓我們繼續這場冒險探索臺大校園，為保護生態環境貢獻了一份力量，下一個任務等著你！

Congratulations on successfully completing Treasure Hunt Mission (3)! What kind of fish did you see? With the support of the Lugong Irrigation Association (now the Lugong Management Office under the Ministry of Agriculture’s Irrigation Agency), the Zhoushan Road Farm Ecological Pond (the Lugong Canal water source pond) was completed in 2004. Designed with ecology, sustainability, conservation, and education in mind, it has become an important landmark on campus and also provides hiding habitats for birds, amphibians, and reptiles on campus. Let’s continue this adventure exploring the NTU campus and contribute to protecting the ecological environment. The next mission is waiting for you!
